# openprovider_domain_auth_code_reset (Resource)

Replaces the auth code of a domain that the account holds with a new code, so the old code no longer transfers the domain. The reset occurs when Terraform creates or replaces the resource. A change of `triggers` replaces the resource. The resource does not keep the new code; use the `openprovider_domain_auth_code` ephemeral resource to read it. The deletion of the resource does not change the domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Replace the auth code of the domain with a new code, so the old code no
# longer transfers the domain. A change of `triggers` resets the code again.
resource "openprovider_domain_auth_code_reset" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"

  triggers = {
    rotation = "2026-10-30"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name (e.g., example.com).

### Optional

- `auth_code_type` (String) The type of the auth code: `external` (the default) to transfer the domain to a different registrar, or `internal` to transfer the domain to a different reseller account at OpenProvider.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values. A change of a value resets the auth code again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The domain name.
